d:
Long, voluminous electric pink hair with a wavy texture and side-swept bangs. Bright amber, cat-like eyes with a playful expression. Appears to be in late adolescence with a youthful face. Slender, athletic build. A red and white traditional miko-style outfit with wide sleeves. Two fluffy, fox-like ears atop the head and a large, bushy pink tail.
BODY COLOR: fair peach
